Print current time.

## Synopsis

```text
time
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Prints the Director's current date and time.

## Examples

Check the Director clock when schedules seem off by a time zone:

```text
time
```
